name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The switch must be toggled at least once" (Existence(switch_toggled)) is redundant because the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) together with the hard Existence(at_exit) already guarantees that a switch toggle occurs before reaching the exit. Remove the redundant Existence(switch_toggled) clause; the remaining clauses correctly express the task: reach the exit (Existence(at_exit)) and flip the switch before reaching it (Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit)).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The switch must be toggled" (Existence(switch_toggled)) is redundant because the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) together with the hard Existence(at_exit) already forces switch_toggled to occur before the exit. Remove this clause; keep the hard Existence(at_exit) and hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit).

texts: The agent must reach the exit
The switch must be toggled before reaching the exit
